name: Home Assistant Panel
description: Home Assistant Panel for the Corsair XENEON Edge. Pick entities from your own Home Assistant instance and keep their current states visible on your desk. Sensors show their values and units, while common binary domains such as lights, switches, locks, covers, and fans show a clear active state. The panel connects directly to your own server with a Home Assistant access token and uses Home Assistant's native WebSocket API for live updates. No cloud relay and no CORS configuration is required for normal operation.
release_notes: Fixes Home Assistant connectivity in imported XENEON widgets by replacing the previous REST-only polling path with Home Assistant's native authenticated WebSocket API. Adds live state_changed updates, reconnect handling, clearer token/server/entity error states, and removes the previous null-CORS setup requirement while preserving existing settings and layout.
